summary: Duplin County steel tower whose erection began in May 1936 under the CCC; the state bought its land in 1961 after the lease expired; no source says what remains.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: Erection of a 99-foot 9-inch steel tower begun by the Civilian Conservation Corps; the listing gives no completion date.
The lease on the site had expired, and the State purchased the land during the summer.

notes_for_editor: The only history found is the Eastern US Lookouts North Carolina listing, which cites state biennial reports (6th 1934-36 and 19th 1962) but those were not read directly. No status, access, staffing, or photos found. A celltowerfinder hit for an FCC tower named Chinquapin, NC (2004) was not read and is probably a different structure. The brief's 21 m elevation (OSM node 357810881) was not checked.
